author: Michael helland
text: Fantastic service.  Gave a heads up call,  showed up on time,  was very polite respectful. Service was quick and efficient and right within quoted price.  Will use thier septic clean out services again and will recommend.

author: acoleman1447
text: We had a wonderful experience with them. We had an issue with a local company trying to rip us off and replace our entire septic pump. A1 Evans drove all the way to Bismarck ASAP and repaired it quickly. They even offered us service over the phone when it froze up on a cold day on a Saturday when it would have been easier to ignore us. We are very grateful for their service and I hope other companies can use them as an example of how to conduct honest business. Thank you guys!

author: Tia Duvall
text: A1 Evan’s was quick on the job and offered expertise to make sure the solution was found! We appreciate you!

author: Raye Genre
text: This company is amazing!  The young men that came to take care of my problem were great!  Highly recommend A-1 Evan’s for any plumbing you need fixed!

author: Ronald Solberg
text: Great service. Septic tank pumping. Very friendly and had very long hose so didn’t have to drive onto lawn.
